candidate_state: released from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, default dependency isolation, opening-book feature tests, USI state-transition smoke, public-contract checks, WebAssembly Chrome tests, and package generation passed. TT buckets and increment use were positive in clean material-only local gates but did not cross the pre-registered paired-trinomial SPRT boundary, so both remain disabled by default.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.58.

known_limitations: The TT-bucket and increment-use A/B gates were positive but statistically inconclusive; neither candidate is enabled by default.
QST, the deeper null-move reduction candidate, and adaptive time-management mode are excluded from this release.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
No general playing-strength or external-engine superiority claim is made for this release.
No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
